title: cgap v26.11.1 extended per-node receipt (schema v2)
description: Per-node execution receipt for the v26.11.1 DFLSS campaign. Sources: docs/jira/v26.11.1/dflss/00-dflss-charter-source.md section 2 and section 4 Phase 4; executor/strings_admitted rationale in docs/jira/v26.11.1/phase-change-charter.md.

lane.description: Producing node's lane id (A01..A20 lane or conversion-engine node id).

files_written.description: Every path this node wrote; nothing outside files_written is attributable to the node.

exit.description: Real observed exit code, not intent.

commands.description: Executed commands with observed exit codes; the grounding for every ALIVE claim.

evidence.description: Pass/flip evidence: command + exit, or the mutation that flipped.

courts_run.description: Courts run by this node; a court that cannot flip is FAIL; skips are loud ([SKIP] <reason>).

standing.description: Campaign standing vocabulary; UNVERIFIED is the default and is never rounded up.

divergences.description: Where the lane doc or dispatch conflicted with reality; the doc yields, the divergence is recorded here.

executor.description: Executor class of the transforms named in this receipt (Steam machinery-share witness; phase-change charter, transition 3).

strings_admitted.description: Runtime string paths this receipt adds (AM->FM diode). Must stay 0; nonzero = falsifier fired = transition not happening. The schema admits the honest nonzero record; the zero-string gate, not this schema, refuses it.

ctq_refs.description: CTQ ids resolved against docs/jira/v26.11.1/dflss/ctq-registry.yaml (charter section 3 VOC->CTQ rows).

doe_refs.description: Charter section 4 Phase 3 generate-and-kill design experiments.
